column1: # [FABLE-5] (sq-hmd7l.20) Pinned timestamped replay — the EXPORTED copy of the fixed
# SRBench-shaped (stream, triple, ts) script in crates/sparq-rsp/examples/rsp_oracle.rs
# (fn srbench_script): an observations stream (<station> <value> v) and a station-metadata
# stream (<station> <state> <usstate>, re-announced each window), joined per synchronized
# tumbling RANGE 10 STEP 10 window. This is the "identical timestamped replay" the bounded
# feeds to external RSP engines (RSP4J/YASPER). Events are sorted by ts (ascending);
# same-ts events keep the in-code script order.
# FIDELITY GUARD: bench/rsp/test_rsp4j_compare.py re-derives the per-window join row
# counts from THIS file and asserts them against bench/rsp/expected.tsv (see the note in
# single_window.ts.tsv for the guard's count-structural scope).
